Sunshine Law & Compliance (Open Meetings)

In accordance with Colorado Sunshine Law for open meetings, the St. Vrain Community Montessori School Board of Directors publicizes the dates and locations of its meetings. Minutes of all meetings are kept in a publicly available archive in the school office.
